description: This Java class defines a custom exception named SavingsAccountChargeWithoutMandatoryFieldException, which extends AbstractPlatformDomainRuleException. It is used to signal the absence of mandatory fields related to savings account charges within the Finch project.

classes.name: SavingsAccountChargeWithoutMandatoryFieldException
classes.description: A custom exception indicating that a required field for savings account charges is missing.

methods.name: SavingsAccountChargeWithoutMandatoryFieldException
methods.description: Constructor that creates a new exception instance with a specific error message key constructed from entity and postfix, along with a default message and optional arguments.
